# VertexAlpha

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Blitz3D](Blitz3D) · [Surfaces](Blitz3D-Surfaces)

</div>


## Command Syntax

```blitzbasic
VertexAlpha:Float32 surface:Int32, index:Int32
```

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `surface` | Int32 | required | Surface handle. |
| `index` | Int32 | required | Index of the vertex, from 0. |

**Returns:** The alpha of the vertex color, 0 for invisible to 1 for solid.

## Description

_Not documented yet._
